02 / CREATE A COIN

From idea to wallet approval.

01

Give it an identity.

Upload a PNG, JPG or WebP up to 8 MB. It is automatically optimized for your token. Add a name, ticker and short description.

02

Add the extras.

Website and X links are optional. Add a developer buy in USDC, or leave it at zero.

03

Approve the launch.

Connect your wallet and sign the ownership message if prompted. Then review and sign the launch transaction.

04

Meet your coin.

Wait for finality. Your token page shows its mint, verified market observations and a link to trade on Pump.

Two different balances.

SOL pays account creation and network fees. USDC is needed only if you choose a developer buy.

Developer buys, metadata and interrupted launches

An optional developer buy is included in the creation transaction. Its amount is a spending cap; Pump may spend less. There is no separate liquidity deposit or 50% developer-buy split.

Your saved PFP and links are pinned to the mint through content-addressed metadata. Launch preparation verifies that the embedded metadata has no update authority. Stabled hosts the metadata; it is not permanent decentralized storage.

If you reject a signature or a transaction expires, reopen the token page. Stabled reconciles the previous preparation before creating a replacement. Do not repeatedly submit the same launch while confirmation is pending.

New coins use Pump’s Token-2022 flow, six token decimals and its standard supply. Mayhem mode and holder rewards are disabled.

03 / USDC PAIRINGS

What “paired with USDC” means.

Your meme coin is the base asset. USDC is the quote asset—the token used to buy it, sell it and express its price.

USDC

The market’s quote.

Prices, market caps, reserves and indexed volume are shown in USDC.

SOL

The network’s fuel.

SOL pays Solana rent and transaction fees. It is not the quote for Stabled pairs.

USDC · SOLANA MAINNETEPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v
The quote is stable. Your coin is not.

USDC is Circle’s dollar stablecoin. A USDC pair means prices read in dollars; it does not hold your meme coin’s price steady or protect it from loss.

Quote verification and earlier coins

USDC on Solana uses the classic SPL Token program and six decimals. Each time it prepares a launch, Stabled checks that USDC is still an approved Pump quote and that the mint matches the address above.

Coins launched earlier with a COINx pair keep that pair on-chain. Their pages still open from a direct link and show COINx prices, but they no longer appear in discovery or on the leaderboard. Legacy BlueMint tokens keep their original Raydium USDC pools and metadata; their listings are retired and their fee claims remain separate.

04 / FEES

Pump fees. No extra Stabled trading fee.

New launches follow Pump’s on-chain trading fee schedule. Your launch wallet is the coin creator and receives eligible creator fees under Pump’s rules.

Legacy BlueMint claims

The former BlueMint LaunchLab markets retain their original 1.25% platform fee and zero creator fee. Their USDC claims go to the existing treasury. The old 40% / 60% allocation does not apply to new Pump coins.

06 / LIQUIDITY

A curve first. A pool next.

01CREATE
02PUMP CURVE
03PUMPSWAP

Trading starts on Pump’s bonding curve. Buys add quote reserves and release tokens; sells move in the opposite direction.

When the curve completes, Pump’s migration process creates its canonical PumpSwap market. A short interval can occur before that pool becomes available. Stabled checks its pool and vault balances after migration.

Liquidity follows Pump’s rules.

No automatic Stabled buyback, fee reinvestment, holder rewards or price floor is enabled. The optional developer buy is a purchase, not a separate liquidity commitment.

07 / CHARTS & THE CROWN

Read the market. Watch the throne.

Price & market cap

Verified finalized reserves determine the quote price. Market cap is that price multiplied by supply.

Candles & reserves

One-minute candles summarize available price observations and indexed curve trades. Reserves show the quote liquidity available to the market, excluding identifiable pool fees.

ROLLING FIVE MINUTES

King of Memes.

The coin with the highest indexed USDC volume in the last five minutes takes the crown. The board refreshes every 15 seconds.

A ≥ before volume means partial history. “Indexing” means the data is unavailable, rather than zero. New finalized curve and PumpSwap trades are indexed, with bounded HTTP backfill; reconnects and history gaps can leave incomplete volume.

Which coins qualify, and where can I trade?

The crown considers listed USDC coins with positive recent indexed volume. Earlier COINx coins and legacy BlueMint markets are excluded. If there are no eligible trades, the throne stays open.

Use Trade on Pump from a token’s page. Axiom and other terminals control their own quote support and indexing; Stabled cannot force their availability.

Every finalized token has a mint-address page at /token/<mint-address>. Retired legacy markets keep their original on-chain mint and pool addresses.
